**Vendetta Forever** fuses rapid-fire tactical gunplay with effortless acrobatic style in an unapologetic love letter to classic action cinema.

# Lo-Kill-Motion
[media]
Kill enemies mid-air, snatch their weapon, and launch yourself across the level. Every kill is your next move.
 
# 60+ levels of cinematic chaos
[media]
Saloon shootouts. Airborne hijackings. Pure cult-action mayhem.
  
# An arsenal worth dying for
[media]
From silenced pistols to pencils, every weapon is iconic.
  
# Just one more run
[media]
Global leaderboards, game-changing modifiers, and stacks of collectibles. The credits never roll.
